title: The Real Reason Why Tom Sosnoff Won’t Trade Stock
description:
Tom Sosnoff explains his preference for options over stocks by comparing "static" versus "strategic" approaches to trading. He discusses how stocks offer limited flexibility as directional plays, while options provide multiple dimensions for risk management and portfolio construction. The conversation explores how options allow traders to adjust probability, manage duration, and customize return distributions, whereas stock investments have predetermined characteristics. This educational perspective examines the structural differences between these two approaches and the strategic differences that options may offer active traders.
